name: Clockify
description_en:
Clockify records project time through timers, timesheets, calendars and kiosk workflows, then supports reporting, approval and billing-related management. Its CAKE.com siblings Pumble and Plaky are distinct communication/project products, not prerequisites for basic time tracking.

The current price page limits Free to five users. Older assumptions of unlimited free team members should not override that dated official snapshot.
description_zh:
Clockify 通过计时器、工时表、日历和 kiosk 记录项目时间，再支持报告、审批及计费相关管理。CAKE.com 的 Pumble、Plaky 是独立沟通/项目产品，不是基础时间记录的前提。

当前定价页将 Free 限为五位用户，不能以旧的免费团队人数不限印象覆盖本次官方快照。

core_features.explanation_en: Use timer, timesheet or kiosk according to the workflow.
core_features.explanation_zh: 依据流程使用计时器、工时表或 kiosk。

core_features.explanation_en: Submit timesheets/expenses, assign approvers and retain approved-request copies.
core_features.explanation_zh: 提交工时/费用、分配审批人并保留已批请求副本。

en: Create projects/tasks, billing rates and team roles, then record a week and submit it for approval. The approval page describes manager review, rejection and archived approved requests. Test a wrong project and a late correction; determine who can edit after locking and how the invoice/export reflects the change. These are recommended checks, not an executed approval.
zh: 创建项目/任务、计费费率和团队角色，记录一周后提交审批。审批页介绍经理审核、拒绝及已批请求归档。应测试错误项目及后续更正，确定锁定后谁可修改、发票/导出如何反映变化。这是建议核对，未实际审批。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: Free up to five users, paid active/invited seats and distinct limited kiosk rates; features vary by tier.

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free 最多五位，付费活跃/受邀席位及独立 kiosk 限制费率；功能按档不同。

sections.title_en: Example: submit a corrected billable week
sections.title_zh: 示例：提交经更正的计费周工时
sections.en: Create projects/tasks, billing rates and team roles, then record a week and submit it for approval. The approval page describes manager review, rejection and archived approved requests. Test a wrong project and a late correction; determine who can edit after locking and how the invoice/export reflects the change. These are recommended checks, not an executed approval.
sections.zh: 创建项目/任务、计费费率和团队角色，记录一周后提交审批。审批页介绍经理审核、拒绝及已批请求归档。应测试错误项目及后续更正，确定锁定后谁可修改、发票/导出如何反映变化。这是建议核对，未实际审批。

sections.title_en: Invited people can occupy paid seats
sections.title_zh: 受邀用户也可能占付费席位
sections.en:
Free is listed for up to five users. Basic is $3.99 per seat monthly equivalent billed annually or $4.99 monthly; Standard $5.49/$6.99, Pro $7.99/$9.99 and Enterprise $11.99/$14.99 in the shown view. Active or invited owners/admins/managers/members occupy paid seats; deactivated users do not. Confirm selected currency and tax.

Limited kiosk-only seats have separate lower rates and access restrictions. The productivity bundle includes other products and has its own data-region caveat, so it is not a simple substitute for every Clockify-only licence. Match approvals, expenses and security requirements to the detailed selected plan.
sections.zh:
Free 列出最多五位用户。所示视图 Basic 年付月均 $3.99、月付 $4.99；Standard $5.49/$6.99、Pro $7.99/$9.99、Enterprise $11.99/$14.99。活跃或已受邀的所有者/管理员/经理/成员占付费席位，已停用用户不占。所选货币及税费需确认。

仅 kiosk 的受限席位有独立较低费率及访问限制。生产力组合包包含其他产品，也有数据地区例外，不能直接替代所有 Clockify 单独许可。审批、费用及安全要求需对应详细套餐。

sections.title_en: An approved timesheet still needs reconciliation
sections.en:
Project teams can evaluate time-to-client billing; field attendance and desktop monitoring need their own selected setup. Reconcile source entries, approval period and rates before exporting payroll or invoices. A missing row can be an unsubmitted/rejected entry, not a failed timer.

No timers, permissions, kiosk, accounting integration, software licence or restore was tested. Hosted access and a Free plan do not establish self-hosting or open-source rights; retention and export completeness remain unverified.
sections.zh:
项目团队可评估时间到客户计费，外勤考勤和桌面监测需各自配置。导出薪资或发票前，核对来源记录、审批周期及费率。缺少一行可能是未提交/被拒，而非计时器故障。

未测试计时器、权限、kiosk、财务集成、软件许可或恢复。托管访问及 Free 不证明自托管或开源权，保留与导出完整性未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)

research_gaps.en: No time/approval/export, regional pricing, licence, security or restore tested; reconcile current five-user cap before migration.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试工时/审批/导出、地区价格、许可、安全或恢复；迁移前需核对当前五用户免费上限。
